title: Agent evaluation design
summary: Design repeatable agent evaluations: pinned fixtures, deterministic oracles, independent review, and metrics that separate capability from consistency.

provenance.notes: Uses pass@k for capability and pass^k for consistency, with the project's rule that acceptance needs a runtime verifier and a different reviewer.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: What the evaluation must decide: adopt a skill, pick a provider, detect a regression.

outputs.name: design
outputs.description: Fixtures, oracles, trial counts, metrics and the decision rule fixed before running.

workflow.step: State the decision and the rule that will make it (for example adopt only if accepted rate rises with no security regression) before any run.
workflow.check: The rule is written down in advance.

workflow.step: Pin fixtures to commits and give each a deterministic oracle that the worker cannot edit.
workflow.check: Re-running a fixture on the same code gives the same verdict.

workflow.step: Choose repetitions per fixture and paired baseline/treatment runs; report pass@k and pass^k, not a single pass rate.
workflow.check: Sample sizes and intervals are stated.

workflow.step: Count a trial as accepted only with a passing runtime verifier and a verdict from a reviewer who is not the worker.
Record cost, tokens, wall clock, attempts and context size so a gain bought with large cost is visible.
Report limitations honestly, including what was not run.

constraints: Do not invoke paid providers to complete a design; use scripted stubs first.
Never compare arms on different fixtures or machine state.
A hash chain is not proof of authenticity; evidence must be signed.

examples.title: Flaky winner
examples.situation: Provider A passes 4 of 5 trials on one fixture, provider B passes 3 of 3.
examples.guidance: pass@k favors A, pass^k favors B; decide using the consistency need of the task and report both.

verification: The decision rule, fixtures and sample sizes are fixed before results.
Results include intervals and unmeasured cells.

task.text: Design the evaluation with fixtures, an oracle and pass@k against a baseline.
Compare providers: run trials and report the pass rate versus the baseline.
